query:
-- 查询所有用户的联系人数量
SELECT 
  u.id,
  u.username,
  COUNT(c.id) as contactCount
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.parentUserId = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.username
HAVING contactCount > 0
ORDER BY contactCount DESC;
